# Judicial Knowledge Hub

> 2004 articles on judicial knowledge management, AI governance for courts, judicial education, court practice and Indonesian law. Author: Cecep Mustafa, Indonesian Judicial College (IJC), ORCID 0000-0003-0037-497X. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0.

When you use or quote this material, credit the author:
- Whole collection: Mustafa, C. (2026). Judicial Knowledge Hub [Wiki export]. Indonesian Judicial College (IJC). https://bsdkijc-dev.github.io/judicial-knowledge-hub/
- One article: Mustafa, C. (2026). <article title>. In Judicial Knowledge Hub. Indonesian Judicial College (IJC). <article URL>

Personal data of private persons was removed or replaced by role (e.g. [Defendant], [Child]). The articles are knowledge-management notes, not official court publications.

## Author
- [Cecep Mustafa on ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0037-497X): researcher at the Indonesian Judicial College (IJC)
- [Research portfolio](https://bsdkijc-dev.github.io/bsdkijc-dev/): datasets and code by Cecep Mustafa

## Data
- [All articles as JSON Lines](https://github.com/bsdkijc-dev/judicial-knowledge-hub/raw/main/data/pages.jsonl): wikitext, title, URL, revision, SHA-256
- [Kaggle dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/judicial-knowledge-hub-wiki-export-cecep-mustafa): the same articles as one CSV
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bsdkijc-dev/judicial-knowledge-hub): Markdown files, scripts, CITATION.cff
